name: Crisis Cleanup Web
humanitarian_domain: Collaborative disaster recovery and volunteer cleanup coordination

impact_evidence.claim: The repository README reports use across 207 disasters in 7 countries, connecting 600,000+ volunteers from 2,500+ organizations with 140,000+ households.
The README reports modeled monetary value and volunteer-efficiency estimates; these are useful scale proxies but not independently measured beneficiary outcomes.

maintenance.current_public_activity: GitHub metadata inspected 2026-09-06 showed the web repository updated in August 2026, but many candidate issues are from 2024 and assigned.
maintenance.current_risk: Issue freshness and assignment status make unsolicited work high-risk without maintainer confirmation.

contribution.pathway: GitHub repository plus CONTRIBUTING/CLA requirement referenced from README.
contribution.ai_policy: No current project-specific AI policy found during first audit.
